checkboxes.description: Success feedback shown after CRUD operations (toast, alert, message)

evidence.reasoning: Mutations only invalidate queries and close modal on success. No toast notification, alert component, or success message implementation found anywhere in codebase. Modal simply closes without explicit user feedback confirming operation succeeded.
onClose callback is the only success handler passed to mutations - no success message, toast notification library, or visual feedback mechanism present in implementation

reasoning: Comprehensive evaluation of Tools page CRUD functionality reveals excellent implementation across 6 of 7 checkboxes. Add Tool modal opens with complete form containing all required fields (name, vendor, category, department, cost, status, URLs) with robust Zod validation. Edit functionality properly pre-fills form with existing tool data via defaultValues prop. Delete operation includes safety-first confirmation dialog with explicit warning and tool name display. Tools page displays significantly more data than Dashboard table (10+ fields vs 5 columns) including category, updated_at, description, and website_url. Pagination fully implemented with Previous/Next navigation, page indicators, and proper disabled states for 12 items per page. Form validation comprehensive with real-time onChange validation, error display, and constraints on all fields. However, success feedback is completely missing - no toast notifications, alerts, or success messages after CRUD operations complete. Modal simply closes without confirming to user that create/update/delete succeeded, which is a UX gap. Total score: 27/30 points (90%).
